import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import brentq
bare = np.diag(np.array([0.8, 0.8, 1.3, 2.1])**2)
centroid = np.array([0.16, -0.12, 0.09, 0.07])
directions = np.array([[1.,.2,-.3,.4],[.1,1.,.5,-.2],[-.4,.3,1.,.1],[.2,-.1,.4,1.],[.7,.7,-.2,.1],[.3,-.6,.6,.4],[-.5,.2,.4,.7],[.6,-.4,-.1,.5]])
cubic = np.array([.8,-.55,.7,.4,-.6,.5,.35,-.45])
quartic = np.array([.9,.7,1.1,.8,.6,1.2,.5,.75])
sextic = np.array([.7,.4,.9,.5,.6,.8,.3,.65])
temperature = 0.7
reference_temperature = 0.7
bracket = np.array([0.5,2.0])
def _numeric_result(function, *args):
    covariance, response = function(*args)
    dimension = len(args[0]); pairs = dimension*(dimension+1)//2
    if np.shape(covariance) != (dimension,dimension) or np.shape(response) != (pairs,pairs):
        raise ValueError('incorrect returned matrix shapes')
    return np.concatenate((np.asarray(covariance).ravel(),np.asarray(response).ravel()))
assert np.allclose(_numeric_result(quantum_matrix_response,bare.copy(),temperature), target)
